item.title: Group of Penn High School students hold walkout protesting ICE Friday
item.description: MISHAWAKA, Ind. -- Penn-Harris-Madison School Corporation released a statement Friday afternoon following a group of approximately 80 Penn High School students participating in what's being called a student-led, unsanctioned walkout as part of a national protest over recent U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement activity.

item.title: Man found guilty of murdering 35-year-old Westville Correctional Facility inmate
item.description: LA PORTE COUNTY, Ind. -- Documents from La Porte County Court reveal Donell Davis, who was charged with the murder of 35-year-old John Taylor at the Westville Correctional Facility in November 2023, was found guilty Thursday.

item.title: Power of community shines at Elkhart County Boys & Girls Clubs art show
item.description: GOSHEN, Ind. — The Boys & Girls Clubs of Elkhart County held its annual art exhibition Friday evening at the Goshen Theater. Kids from the Middlebury, Nappanee, Goshen, and Elkhart clubs filled the walls with art, all fitting the theme of the contest, ‘The Power of Us’.
